name: Industrial Humanoid Robot
summary: Spider Robot Industrial Humanoid Robot is a wheeled, dual-arm manipulation platform for flexible manufacturing. The manufacturer describes an autonomous mobile base, a lifting and tilting torso, stereo vision, force sensing and whole-body motion planning. Intended tasks include machine loading and unloading, workpiece transfer, visual sorting, pallet handling and bin transport. The official 2026 World Robot Conference exhibit and manufacturer brochure establish this specific product; commercial availability and deployed production performance remain unverified.
